Key GWAS Observations (Population & Repl: Strongest T2DM GWAS signal. Replicated in EUR, SAS, AFR, EAS. Higher T allele freq in SAS (0.318) than EUR (0.292). ~21% population attributable risk (EUR).
T2DM effect primarily mediated through BMI/adiposity. Similar effect in EUR and SAS. Weaker in EAS. Mediterranean diet abolishes genetic effect (PREDIMED trial).
Protective allele. Significant in EUR meta-analyses. Lower Ala allele frequency in SAS (0.082) than EUR (0.121). Interaction with PUFA alters direction.
Missense E23K. High frequency in both SAS (0.422) and EUR (0.441). Interacts with dietary glycemic index. Effect replicated in South Asian GWAS.
Intron variant. Increases islet MTNR1B expression. Interaction with meal timing (late-night eating). Relevant for urban South Asian lifestyle patterns.
3? UTR variant reduces adiponectin. South Asian women show strong association. Omega-3 interaction modifies adiponectin response.
Missense Gly972Arg reduces IRS-1 PI3K signalling. Effect amplified by high animal protein intake in EPIC-InterAct study (n=27,779).
